scientific_intent.scientific_task: Compute complete orthonormal forward and inverse8x8 discrete cosine transforms of image tiles
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: For each full8x8 tile, forward C*X*C^T and inverse C^T*X*C, C[k,n]=sqrt(1/8) for k0 and.5*cos((2n+1)k*pi/16) otherwise
scientific_intent.discretization: Disjoint full8x8 image tiles, no inter-tile boundary extension. Four image fixtures:64x32 native-seeded random;67x35 signed pattern with stride73;32x16 constant.25;32x16 asymmetric unit impulse. Inverse is applied to original input, as source, not to forward output inside timed region.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: 10240 transformed values and1014 unchanged partial-tile/stride-padding sentinels,11254 complete outputs per trial. Independent Float64 mathematical DCT-II/III, orthonormality and per-tile energy identities; original native Float32fast CPU relativeL2<1e-6 also passes. All20 full arrays pass same1e-5+1e-6relative mathematical tolerance; dual portable comparisons max1.6541e-6.
scientific_intent.input_size_regime: Four small32..67 pixel-wide images,80 full8x8 tiles per direction,20 repeated batches of8 forward/inverse calls. This is not the8192² source Makefile size or an end-to-end codec.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Native/portable butterfly constants are rounded Float32; existing CUDAjl uses Float32 pi/cos and64-term accumulation. Independent oracle uses Float64 exact-form basis. Relative errors near zero are ill-conditioned, so absolute+relative tolerance and full-matrix relativeL2 are reported separately.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Block spectral analysis and image compression transforms. No quantization, entropy coding, compressed-file output or codec quality/perceptual metric is implemented.
scientific_intent.description: Complete8x8 orthonormal forward/inverse transforms, including DC-only constant and asymmetric impulse witnesses, signed input, non-square fullgroups, unused stride padding and unprocessed partial8x8 edges.
scientific_intent.provenance: Native source is a fast separable shared-memory butterfly. Genuine existing CUDAjl is a direct two-dimensional64-term cosine transform; both are mathematically equivalent and preserved. KA/JACC translate native butterfly mapping with explicit conservative workgroup barriers. Original sources and Makefile preserved; no native arithmetic correction.
